title: FastVideo Open Sources FastH3 Omni for 12x Faster Video on Nvidia Blackwell
summary:
The weights and training code for the MiniMax FastH3 Omni video generation model are now available as open source via the FastVideo project. The model achieves real time generation speeds 12x faster on Nvidia Blackwell GPUs and supports NVFP4 and FP8 formats for Spark and RTX hardware. Developed in collaboration with Nvidia AI, Nuva Lab, and Reactor, the system enables 8 step reference to video generation.

The release provides day 0 support for ComfyUI and vLLM Omni, which allows the model to be served on consumer RTX GPUs. Some early users state that the performance and end to end open source nature of the project make the model a rival to the H3 Max developed by fal.ai.
